about: What done means. Each requirement has a check the pipeline can run, or is 'manual' (a person confirms it). See mechkit/requirements.py for the check types.

requirements.text: The display and the C3 board mount: holes line up, screws engage, nothing collides
Every printed part fits the Bambu A1 bed
The clamp carries the unit plus a 5 N cable tug with a safety factor of 3
Nothing rises more than 24 mm up the front of the monitor (the picture is never covered)
Clamps on and comes off without marking the monitor; stays put when bumped
The screen is readable from the normal seat (tilt is right)
Shows day, time and weather; the background follows season, weather and sun position
The firmware builds from the pin map with no hand-edited pin numbers
